hypothesis: Grouping adjacent windows reduces repeated input bytes and dispatch overhead but may reduce parallelism; report both gains and losses against ground relay and literature rules
fixed_work: 64 identical 4096 inference windows per image, same measured cohort curve, same arrivals and exogenous detections across methods/groups

result_model.meaning: Controlled synthetic output-load assumption, not measured port density or SAR accuracy
result_model.overlap_rule: Same object may appear in multiple window outputs; all outputs sent before ground merge
result_model.information_rule: Actual result sizes only exposed after all windows in that dispatch packet finish; scheduling before compute uses population mean
result_model.compute_rule: Fixed service independent of detection count; conservative proxy retaining measured controlled postprocessing cost, not a new benchmark
result_model.empty_rule: Every window must compute and return its 28-byte completion header; no image/preview for empty detections

transport.compression_assumption: Uncompressed/compressed size ratio; fixed modeling assumption, not measured codec performance
transport.inference_rule: bands/bits_per_sample define model input and VRAM proxy, independently of native transport
transport.compute_rule: Per-window processing proxy; not a measured native PAN/MS pipeline; decode/pansharpen cost not modeled
